title: Triple Hills: Cain against Genghis
lede: Genghis Khan and the riders of the Golden Khaganate against the Covenant of New Jerusalem's Penitent Crusade under Cain, the First Penitent, on Triple Hills. The closest of six: Genghis led 25 to 13 after Round 5, died on Cain's Knight-Apostles in Round 6, and the Crusade won 33 to 28 in Round 7. Over the six battles the Crusade won 4 to 2.
result_line: Penitent Crusade wins on Victory Points, 33 to 28
deployment: The Khaganate set up on rows 12 to 14: Genghis leading the Khesig Guards at (3,14), the Black Shaman leading Stormrider 1 at (4,14), Stormrider 2 at (9,14), the Nerge Outriders at (10,14), and two Tamga-Bound Troops squads at (6,12) and (7,12), one requisitioned. The Crusade set up on row 2: Cain leading the Knight-Apostle Squad at (9,2), the Cantor-Preceptor leading Covenant Levies 1 at (10,2), Levies 2 and 3 at (5,2) and (11,2), the Jordanite Hospitallers at (3,2), and a fourth Levies squad requisitioned at (8,2). Neither faction offers these armies a doctrine.

feed.text: Both spend 3 CP on Troop Requisition: a second Tamga-Bound Troops squad for Genghis, a fourth Covenant Levies squad for the Crusade.
Everyone Advances. Genghis and the Khesig Guards ride to (7,9) and the Stormriders to (6,9) and (7,11); the Levies come down to rows 3 to 6, the requisitioned squad to (8,6).
0 each.

A Tamga-Bound squad charges onto the centre at (7,7) through Overwatch from four Crusade units (4 HP, and a stray Levies shot hits its own side for 3). The Hospitallers charge it. Genghis' pair rides west to (4,9), Stormrider 2 to (3,9), the Outriders east to (12,8).
The requisitioned Levies take 10 HP off the Tamga-Bound Troops and lose 7 to the strike back. Genghis, the Khesig Guards, Stormrider 2 and the other Tamga squad shoot Levies 2 for 14.
The Khaganate holds all three objectives (7) and completes FOCUSED FIRE (+2); INTO THE FRAY for the Crusade (+2). Genghis 9, Crusade 2.

Genghis' pair charges north to (4,5); Cain and the Knight-Apostles, Double Timed, charge it at (5,4). Stormrider 2 charges the Hospitallers; the Tamga-Bound squad on the centre Falls Back in disorder (3 HP).
The Knight-Apostles take 8 off the Khesig Guards for 3 of their own, and Cain destroys the last of them: Genghis stands alone. Stormrider 2 takes 3 off the Hospitallers.
Genghis keeps the centre (3) and IRON GRIP (+2); the Crusade scores BLEED THEM WHITE (2) and BREAK CONTACT (+2). Genghis 14, Crusade 6.
Genghis Falls Back alone, in disorder, to (0,6) (3 HP); Cain's pair and Levies 2 charge on to (5,6) and (6,6).
Stormrider 2 destroys the Jordanite Hospitallers. A Levies squad shooting into the melee destroys its own Levies 2 (2 HP).
The Khaganate holds all three objectives again (7). Genghis 21, Crusade 6.

Cain's pair charges to (6,7), onto the centre; a requisitioned Levies squad charges to (5,7) and another walks to (11,7). Both Stormrider squads fall back off the centre in disorder (5 HP). Genghis charges Levies 1 on the west objective.
Levies 1 strike Genghis and lose 2 HP back.
The Crusade holds two objectives (5) and IRON GRIP (+2); Genghis scores WIDE SWEEP (2) and the west objective (2). Genghis 25, Crusade 13.
Genghis spends 4 CP on Secure Objective for the Nerge Outriders, who then Fall Back in disorder (1 HP); the Khaganate scores no objective this round.
Genghis charges again, to (2,6), and Cain's pair charges in beside him at (3,6).
Genghis strikes the Knight-Apostles for 3 and is destroyed, 9 HP. A Levies squad shoots the Tamga-Bound Troops for 8.
The Crusade holds all three objectives (7) and BLEED THEM WHITE (2); the Khaganate scores nothing. Genghis 25, Crusade 22.
A Tamga-Bound squad dies in a disordered Fall Back. Both Stormrider squads charge Levies 3 on the centre.
The Stormriders destroy Levies 3 (12 HP). The Knight-Apostles destroy a Tamga-Bound squad (11), and three Levies squads shoot the last one for 13.
The Crusade holds two objectives (5), BLEED THEM WHITE (2) and MAN OF THE HOUR (+4); KING OF THE HILL (+3) for Genghis. Genghis's Army 28, Penitent Crusade 33.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.html:
The Crusade four to two

The Crusade won 4 of 6, on average 24.7 VP to 21.7. Ground was even (14.2 objective VP a battle for Genghis, 13.2 for the Crusade) and so were the secondaries (6.0 and 6.7); the difference was the Primary, 4.8 VP a battle to 1.5. Damage was even (81 to 79), but Genghis lost 49 RP a battle to the Crusade's 33, 125 of them in the featured battle. Every battle but the featured one was decided by 20 or more.

Two of these battles, seeds 1240 and 1242, first crashed the page in Round 7: V8 ran out of memory. The cause was the unit list's row cache, which kept about half a GB of memory each Battle Round, in every matchup. It is fixed and both battles were played again; the same seeds give the same battles, so they stand beside the other four.

{{batch}}{{chart:batch-vp}}{{chart:batch-sources}}

Who scored

For Genghis, the Stormriders scored 3.4 VP a squad and Genghis 3.6, the Khesig Guards 3.0, the cheap Tamga-Bound Troops 14.8 per 100 RP. For the Crusade, the Knight-Apostle Squad scored 4.9 a battle and Cain 3.6; the Covenant Levies 22.4 per 100 RP. The Jordanite Hospitallers were destroyed in 5 of 6.

{{chart:batch-unit-vp}}{{chart:batch-unit-vp-rp}}

What the armies did

  • Cain and the Knight-Apostles decide the fights. In the featured battle they destroyed the Khesig Guards in one round, and when Genghis came back alone in Round 6 he died on them. Agnus Dei put +1 DMG on them and the Levies, 34 expected HP over six battles (10 of 18 casts bought nothing).
  • Genghis gave up a 12-point lead. From Round 5 the Khaganate's riders fell back off the hills and Genghis charged on alone; the Crusade's cheap Levies took the objectives back and scored 9 and 11 in the last two rounds.
  • The Black Shaman's Chant of the Kindling was cast 27 times (54 Mana) and the record found it bought nothing in 22. It raises Hunger, which pays only through the Khaganate's Hunger rules; the record prices little of that.
  • Friendly fire. In the featured battle the Crusade's Levies hit their own side twice shooting into melee and destroyed Levies 2 once.
{{chart:batch-unit-inaction}}

How sure

Four to two with even damage and ground is a slight lean to the Crusade, from its Primary scoring and the Knight-Apostles. The AI threw away Genghis in the featured battle; that is the AI's play, not the army.

closing: Why Genghis, alone and wounded, charged the Knight-Apostles in Round 6, and whether the record should price Hunger gained.
